notes.title: Relive memories of going to the arcade in Point Rescue Arcade
notes.notes:
Point Rescue Arcade is a game that very much leans into the experience you might have had when going to a real Arcade, grabbing a big gun and sticking in some coins.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/07/relive-memories-of-going-to-the-arcade-in-point-rescue-arcade
